chapter: Arriving in New York: the Nest Club and Harlem nightlife
title: The Silver Grill closes without pay and the Fordham Club
summary: After the Nest Club, Danny played with Tommy Jones at the racketeer-run Silver Grill, which closed after a week unpaid, then at the Fordham Club in the Bronx.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: After the Nest Club, I went with Tommy Jones. We went over and played at a little club for about a week, across the river in West New York, called The Silver Grill, which was run by racketeers, the West Side Mob -- and stayed over there. And one night when we went to work, they said, 'The
club is closed." They had trouble with the police. We come back with no salary, and we'd worked almost a week.
From there I go in the Fordham Club up in the Bronx. It was college kids -- a different atmosphere of people altogether.
